title: CardDefinition
description: One hand-card / ritual JSON document (src/server/content/cards/<card-id>.json). Every card has a forge region. Play uses at most one of effect, equipment, overload, or ritual — locked to type. Print (rulesText) is player-facing authority; structured regions are engine authority.

playCost.description: Header [Spend: …] burned from the attribute pile when playing or forging (synthetic forge burns; natural forge does not). 1-token totals are exceptional — prefer 2+ of the card's attribute.

subtypes.description: Modifiers after Modify or Response. A ritual region uses continuous or reaction. Instant subtype is retired.

forgeTags.description: Tags that satisfy face forge restrictions (echo for Arcane Echo).

rulesText.description: English effect-region print below "or". Empty string means forge-only ("Does not have"). Use KEYWORDS timing prefixes: On roll: [Mark 1 Toxin].

effect.description: Instant / reaction one-shot. Absent when unimplemented, forge-only, or when the playable region is equipment / overload / ritual.

equipment.description: Required when type is equipment. mayTargetOpponent, optional creatureAttributes, abilities (standing triggers).

overload.description: Required when type is overload. Optional faceSymbols / faceKinds gates; onRoll (required, may be empty); optional onAbsorb.

ritual.description: Required when type is ritual. activeWhen ([Active when]), spend ([Spend] on activate), effects (activate payload, may be empty), standingAbilities (continuous while ready).

fighterRestriction.description: Spec 028. Legal only if this creature definition is in your living squad.

archetypeRestriction.description: Spec 028. Legal if any living squad fighter's archetype matches.

seizesOffense.description: Spec 030. Response that takes offensive control when it resolves against a waiting combat action. Does not cancel that action's damage.

modifySubject.description: Spec 030. What a Modify acts on. Not a separate card type.

exceptionalMeterCost.description: Spec 030. Meter for exceptional mode only. Normal mode does not spend this.

lifecycle.description: Spec 030. Omit to derive: an equipment or overload region, or a continuous ritual region, stays in play. Other cards are one-shot.

afterResolveZone.description: Spec 030. One-shot destination after the card resolves. Omit to discard (graveyard).
